04 / Current-draft review

Inspect every session, load and constraint before marking this synthetic draft reviewed. Any input, result or reviewer-label edit clears the mark. Import always requires a fresh review.

Local unauthenticated acknowledgment. Separate from source approval and issuing authority.

Scope & limits
Synthetic data only. Not an issued schedule. This two-day view does not establish weekly coverage. Feasibility applies only to listed starts.

Not implemented:

Recurrence and SFTRM interpretation
Departmental negotiation/agents
Real readiness data
Qualification policy beyond supplied values
Official-calendar writes
Reconnect sync

The example rest and duty caps are demonstration inputs, not approved fatigue policy. No credentials, identity service, backend or operational connections.

Nothing is saved automatically. Save JSON before closing; reopen this HTML and import the file to recover inputs and draft. Local file transfer is not synchronization. Keep this prototype synthetic.

Training Draft v1 · Standalone prototype · Human acceptance and operational validation remain separate.
